values.note: A permit and reservation are always required, on the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests reservation site or 888-PA-PARKS. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/delaware/camping ('A permit and reservation is always required for motorized, roadside camping', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite', 'Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880251&siteId=23604 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific', 'Checkin Time: 3:00 pm'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A single roadside site, E011 Maple Run (Edgemere loop), off PA 402 about 4 miles south of I-84, directly connected to the Maple Run ATV and snowmobile trailhead and parking area. Pull-in on a 75-ft gravel driveway; the site itself is listed 20 x 30 ft, no max vehicle length is given, and the booking site files it under Tent Site only. Limited to 2 vehicles.

note: Delaware State Forest motorized roadside site E011 Maple Run (Edgemere area), off PA 402 about 4 miles south of I-84, beside the Maple Run ATV and snowmobile trailhead parking area. Pull-in gravel driveway (75 ft) to a 20 x 30 ft site; the booking site lists no max vehicle length and files it as a tent site.
